source: RFC 7519 §5.2, §7.1, §11.2; RFC 7518 §4.3; conformance/tools/jwt-oracle (node:crypto, Node v24.21.0, OpenSSL 3.5.8)
description: jwt.issue with encrypt to an RSA public key (the RFC 7515 A.2 key, n and e only): ES256 sign, then RSA-OAEP-256 + A256GCM, which is a public-key operation polyjose supports (ADR 0021, ADR 0022). Encrypt-only: polyjose has no RSA private-key decryption (ADR 0021), so there is no validate and the round trip is skipped; the runner checks only that the result is a five-part compact JWE (conformance/README.md jwt.issue)
